text: Skill On Demand 是面向 DSH 的技能按需发现与加载插件：它为每个 agent 注册技能列表、选择和加载工具，并在每个会话注入一次压缩技能索引。用户可以按关键词搜索技能说明、记录当前任务需要的技能，或按名称加载单个技能的完整内容；任务匹配还会提供相关技能提示，并在网页任务中提示可用的浏览器能力。适合安装了多个 DSH 技能、希望按需查找和读取技能的用户。代码没有声明 API Key 或外部服务配置。

Skill On Demand helps DSH users search skill descriptions, select task skills, and load a skill by name. It registers these tools and adds a compact skill index once per session, with relevant skill and browser hints. The code declares no API key or external service.
我想按关键词找出当前可用的技能说明。
让 DSH 只把任务相关的技能全文按需加载进来。
Can I search installed skill descriptions and load one skill's full instructions by name?
Skill On Demand 的功能「按需检索与加载技能」：为 agent 提供按关键词搜索技能名称和说明的工具，并可按精确名称读取一个技能的完整内容。模型调用 `skill_list` 搜索，调用 `skill` 并传入技能名加载正文。

dsh-skill-on-demand README · dsh-skill-on-demand：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

DeepSeek Harness injects every installed skill's full description into each request. With dozens of skills that is tens of thousands of tokens re-sent every turn, most of it about skills the task never touches. Removing the catalog outright saves the tokens but makes skills invisible: the model stops calling them.

dsh-skill-on-demand README · dsh-skill-on-demand：This plugin lands in the middle: a **one-line index** of every skill (name + a short clause from its description), injected once per session, and full instructions loaded only on demand.

dsh-skill-on-demand README · What it does：| Before | With this plugin |
| --- | --- |
| Full 500-char description per skill, re-sent every turn | One line per skill (`name: <28-char clause>`), once per session |
| Nothing searchable mid-session | `skill_list query=关键词` ranks the full descriptions and returns the closest matches |
| Nothing records what a task uses | `skill_pick` optionally records the chosen skills |
| Every body reachable but unmeasured | `skill` loads exactly one full body, by name |

dsh-skill-on-demand README · What it does：The index is about a third of the full catalog, so the model can still read what each skill does; the expensive full descriptions and bodies stay out until needed.

dsh-skill-on-demand README · How the full catalog is removed：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill` publishes its catalog only while `ctx.tools.get('skill', agent)` resolves to its own tool registration. This plugin registers a same-name `skill` tool in each agent's own scope (the nearest scope wins), so that check fails and the catalog stops being published. The replacement tool does the same job — load one skill's instructions by exact name.

Presets that never mounted a `skill` tool are left untouched.
section: How the full catalog is removed

text:
dsh-skill-on-demand README · Deterministic hints：- A request that reads like browser work (网页 / 浏览器 / 抓取 / 登录 / screenshot / browser …) → name the `browser_*` tools (or `browser-skill` if the tools are absent).
- A `web_*` tool call fails → point at `browser_session` → `browser_page` → `browser_inspect`.
- Every message is matched against all skill descriptions locally (CJK bigrams + latin words, common phrases filtered); up to three matches are named with an 80-character description, once each per session.

dsh-skill-on-demand README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-on-demand
```

Restart the harness afterwards; the bundle is loaded at boot.

dsh-skill-on-demand README · Verify：Start a new session and ask anything. The first turn should show the compact `<available_skills>` index, one line per skill, and `skill_list query=简历` should return `resume-builder`.

dsh-skill-on-demand README · Limitations：- The 28-character clause is a truncation, not a summary; a few skills need `skill_list query=` or `skill` to be understood.
- Selection via `skill_pick` is optional and per session.
- A session that already carried the full catalog still shows it, plus the shipped plugin's "no skills available" correction. Start a fresh session for a clean slate.
- If a preset registered `skill` in the agent's own layer, registration fails and the plugin degrades to "picker tools available, full catalog unchanged".

dsh-skill-on-demand README · Development：`index.js` is a single Host plugin, no build step. Run the self-check from inside the installed package, so module resolution reaches the harness's own `@deepseek-ai/*` packages:

```sh
node <profile>/node_modules/dsh-skill-on-demand/scripts/selftest.mjs
```
